name: hunt_dm_vwflip15_rth_midpm

source.title: Claude hunt 2026-10-20 (designer: momentum on a close): the day's VWAP flip, held for two closes, after the morning. Why it should pay: the VWAP from 09:30 is the day's benchmark price for institutional execution; a 15-minute close that crosses it and then holds the new side for two more closes shows the day's control has changed hands, and benchmark-tracking algos, hedgers and trend followers then lean the new way. Who loses: the traders still positioned on the old side of the day's average price (the morning's trend holders and the dip buyers / rally sellers at the VWAP), whose stops sit beyond it. Its trades come on turning days, the days the trend-day legs (noise band, day-range break) stand aside.

entry.words: From 11:00 ET, on NQ 15-minute closes against the VWAP anchored at 09:30: a close that crosses from below to above the VWAP and then two more closes that stay above it is a long at the second of those closes; the mirror (cross below, two more closes below) is a short. Stop 40 points, target 60 points (1:1.5). The first such flip of each pass (mid 11:00-13:30, pm 13:30-15:58): up to two a day, flat 15:58.

[Claude hunt 2026-10-20] the rth anchor (the VWAP from 09:30, the day's benchmark, not the pass's own VWAP), NQ 15-minute bars, mid and pm passes only, both sides, one flip per pass, fixed 40 / 60 point bracket (1:1.5)

not_run: THE STOP: the family has no structure level (ATR fallback): the fixed 40 / 60 point bracket is the sheet's.

THE PASS START: the family's cross-and-hold count restarts at each pass start (11:00, 13:30), so a cross before 11:00 does not count and the first flip of a pass needs a cross inside it; the VWAP itself runs from 09:30 all day.
THE ENTRY is at the close of the second bar that held the new side (30 minutes after the crossing close), not at the cross.

THE CAP IS PER SESSION PASS, NOT PER DAY: max_trades 1 counts inside each of the 2 passes, so a day can hold up to 2 trades; the passes are independent instances, so a trade of one pass may still be open when the next pass enters (one position at a time holds inside a pass only; the hunt's stack step applies one-at-a-time across legs).
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage on market and stop fills, $4 a round turn, tick replay, 1 NQ).
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on an equity half day); no entry in the last 5 minutes of a pass.
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ by this sheet: build days only (2021-09-22 .. 2025-06-30); the 3:1 block walk-forward is a separate, pre-registered read (hunt PREREG Gate 2).
